samADirupatizWate tataH samADijA prajYA tataH prajYAkftAH saMskArA iti navonavaH saMskArASayo jAyate tataH prajYA tataSca saMskArA iti । kaTamasO saMskArAtiSayaScittaM samAptADikAraM na karizyatIti? “atrEva yogijanaprasidDAnvarTasaMjYAkaTanena yogisaMmatimAha । ftamBareti Agameneti vedavihitaM SravaRamuktam । anumAneneti mananaM, DyAnaM cintA tatrAByAsaH pOnaH punyenAnuzWAnaM tasmin rasa AdaraH tatrEva gfhRAti yadA tvaByAsavErAgyAByAmapAstarajastamomalamanavadyavESAradyamuddyotate tadAsyAtipatitasamastamAnameyasImnaH prakASavattve sati kiM nAma yanna gocara iti BAvaH । vyAcazwe SrutamAgamajYAnaM tatsAmAnyavizayaM kasmAt? nahyAgamena SakyoviSezo'BiDAtuM, kutaH? yasmAdAnantyAdvyaBicArAcca na viSezeRa kftasaNketaH SabdaH yasmAdasya viSezeRa saha vAcyavAcakasambanDaH pratIyeta v: sUryyavaMSye nfpaBede । “BagIraTasuto rAjA” ityupakramya “ayutAjitsutasyAsIdftaparRRo mahAyaSAH । divyAkzahfdayajYo'yaM rAjA nalasaKo balI । ftaparRRasutaScAsIdArtta parRRirbahIpatiH” harivaM॰ 16 a॰ । tasya ca nalena saKyamakzahfdayajYatvaYca BA॰ va॰ 72 a॰ darSitaM yaTA “evamukto nalenATa tadA BANgAsurirnfpaH । AsasAda vane rAjan! PalavantaM viBItakam । taM dfzwvA vAhukaM rAjA tvaramARo'ByaBAzata । mamAmi sUta! paSya tvaM saNKyAne paramaM balam । sarvaH sarvaM na jAnAti sarvajYo nAsti kaScana । nEkatra parinizWAsti jYAnasya puruze kvacit । vfkze'smin yAni parRAni PalAnyapi ca vAhuka! । patitAnyapi yAnyatra tatrEkamaDikaM Satam । ekamatrADikaM patraM PalamekaYca vAhuka । paYcakowyo'Ta patrARAM dvayorapi ca SAKayoH । pracinuhyasya SAsve dve yAScAyanyAH praSAKivAH । AByAM Palasahasre dve paYconaM Satameva ca । tato raTamavasTApya rAjAna vAhuko'bravIt । parokzamiva me rAjan! katTase SatrukarzaRa! । pratyakzametat karttAsmi SAtayitvA viBItakam । aTatra gaRite rAjan! vidyate na parokzatA । pratyakzaM te mahArAja! SAtayizye viBItakam । ahaM hi nABijAnAmi BavedevaM na veti vA । saNKyAsyAmi PalAnyasya paSyataste janADipa! । muhUrttamapi vArzReyo raSmIn yacCatu vAjinAm । tamabravInnfpaH sUtaM nAyaM kAlo vilambitum । vAhukastvabravIdenaM paraM yatnaM samAsTitaH । pratIkzasva muhUrttaM tvamaTa vA tvarate BavAn । eza yAti SivaH panTA yAhi vAzRarye! sAraTiH । abravIdftuparRastu sAntvayan kurunandana! । tvameva yantA nAnyo'sti pfTivyAmapi vAhuka! । tvatkfte yAtumicCAmi bdirBA hayakovida! । SaraRaM tvAM prapanno'smi na viGnaM karttumarhasi । kAmaYca te karizyAmi yanmAM vakzyasi vAhuka! । vidarBAM yadi yAtvAdya sUryyaM darSayitAsi me । aTAbravIdvAhukastaM saMKyAya ca viBItakam । tato vidarBAM yAsyAmi kuruzvEvaM vaco mama । akAma iva taM rAjA gaRayasvetyuvAca ha । so'vatIryya raTAttUrRRaM SAtayAmAsa taM drumam । tataH sa vismayAvizwo rAjAnamidamabravIt । gaRayitvA yayoktAni tAvantyeva PalAni ca । atyadButamidaM rAjan! dfzwavAnasmi te balam । SrotumicCAmi te vidyAM yayEtaj jYAyate nfpa! । tamuvAca tato rAjA tvarito gamane nfpaH । vidDyakzahfdayajYaM mAM saNKyAne ca viSAradam । vAhukastamuvAcATa dehi vidyAmimAM mama । matto'pi cASvahfdayaM gfhARa puruzarzaBa । ftuparRRastato rAjA vAhukaM kAryyagOravAt । hayajYAnasya loBAcca taM taTetyabravIdvacaH । yaToktaM tvaM gfhARedamakzARAM hfdayaM param । nikzepo me'SvahfdayaM tvayi tizWatu vAhuka!” । nalasya vAhukacCadmarUpatAmupavarRya anta, uktaM yaTA “ftuparRRo'pi SuSrAva vAhukacCadminaM nalam । damayantyA samAyuktaM jahfze ca narADipaH । tamAnAyya nalaM rAjA kzamayAmAsa pArTivam । sa ca ta kzamayAmAsa hetuBirbudDisammataH! । sa satkfto mahIpAlo nEzaDaM vismitAnanaH । uvAca vAkyaM tattvajYo nEzaDaM vadatAM varaH । dizwyA sameto dArEH svErBavAnityaByanandata । kaccittu nAparADaM te kftavAnasminEzaDa! । ajYAtavAsaM vasato madgfhe vasuDADipa! । yadi vA budDipUrvARi yadyabudDyApi kAnicit । mayA kftAnyakAryyAki tAni tvaM kzantumamarhasi । nala uvAca । na me'parADaM kftavAMstvaM svalpamapi pArTiva! । kfte'pi ca na me kopaH kzantavyaM hi mayA tava । pUrvaM hyapi saKA me'si sambanDI ca janADipa! । ata UrdDantu BUyastvaM prItimAharttumarhasi । sarvakAmEH suvihitEH suKamasmyuzitastvayi । na taTA svagfhe rAjan! yaTA tava gfhe sadA । idaYcEva hayajYAnaM tvadIyaM mayi tizWati । tadupAharttumicCAmi manyase yadi pArTiva! । evamuktvA dadO vidyAmftaparRRAya nEzaDaH । sa ca tAM pratijagrAha viDidfzwena karmmaRA । gfhItvA cASvahfdayaM rAjan! a: ऋतुः — [ऋ-तु-किच्च Uṇ. 1. 71] 1 A season, period of the year, commonly reckoned to be six; शिशिरश्च वसंतश्च ग्रीष्मो वर्षाः शरद्धिमः; sometimes only five; शिशिर and हिम or हेमंत being counted together; cf. पंचर्तवो हेमंतशिशिरयोः समासेन Ait. Br. --2 An epoch, a period any fixed or appointed time. --3 Menstruation, courses, menstrual discharge. --4 A period favourable for conception; वरमृतुषु नैवाभिगमनं Pt. 1; ऋतुः स्वाभाविकः स्त्रीणां रात्रयः षोडश स्मृताः Ms. 3. 46, 9. 70; Y. 1. 11, 79. --5 Any fit season or right time. --6 Fixed order or rule. --7 Light, splendour. --8 A month. --9 N. of Viṣṇu. --10 A symbolical expression for the number ‘six.’ --11 A kind of collyrium. --Comp. --अंतः {1} the close of a season. {2} termination of menstruation. --कालः, समयः, -वेला {1} the time of menstruation, time favourable for conception, i. e. 16 nights from menstrual discharge; see ऋतु above. {2} the duration of a season. --गणः the seasons taken collectively. --गामिन् a. having intercourse with a wife (at the time fit for conception, i. e. after the period of menstruation). --ग्रहः a libation offered to the seasons, a kind of sacrifice. --धामन् m. N. of Viṣṇu. --पतिः {1} the lord of seasons, i. e. the spring. {2} N. of Agni. --पर्णः N. of a king of Ayodhyā; son of Ayutāyu, a descendant of Ikṣvāku. [Nala, king of Niṣadha, entered into his service after he had lost his kingdom and suffered very great adversity. He was ‘profoundly skilled in dice’; and he exchanged with Nala this skill for his skill in horsemanship; and by virtue of it the king succeeded in taking Nala to Kuṇḍinapura before Damayantī had put into execution her resolve of taking a second husband]. --पर्यायः, --वृत्तिः the revolution of the seasons. --पाः m. N. of Indra. --पात्रं the cup in which the libation is offered. --प्राप्त a. fertile, fruitful. --मुखं the beginning or first day of a season. --याजः a sacrifice offered to the seasons. --राजः the spring. --लिंगं {1} a characteristic or sign of the season (as the blossom of the mango tree in spring). {2} a symptom of menstruation. --ष्ठा --(स्था) a. fixed at the proper seasons. --संहारः ‘collection of the seasons,’ N. of Kālidāsa's work on the six seasons. --संधिः {1} the junction of two seasons. {2} the last day in the bright fort-night (पौर्णमासी) and in the dark one (दर्श). --सात्म्यं diet &c. suited to the season. --स्तोमः a kind of sacrifice. --स्नाता a woman who has bathed after menstruation and who is, therefore, fit for sexual intercourse; धर्मलोपभयाद्राज्ञीमृतुस्नातामिमां स्मरन् R. 1. 76. --स्नानं bathing after menstruation.
